```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(rstan)
library(scales)

select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter

rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
options(mc.cores = 2)
```

```{r cargar-datos}
ratings_train <- read_csv("output/ratings_train.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
ratings_test  <- read_csv("output/ratings_test.csv",  show_col_types = FALSE)
Q_matrix      <- read_csv("output/Q_matrix.csv",      show_col_types = FALSE)

TOP4 <- c("Drama", "Comedy", "Thriller", "Romance")
cat("Datos cargados.\n")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 1. Preparación de los datos para Stan

```{r datos-stan}
set.seed(123)
usuarios_sample <- sample(unique(ratings_train$userId), 100)

ratings_sub <- ratings_train %>%
  filter(userId %in% usuarios_sample) %>%
  mutate(rating = pmax(1, as.integer(round(rating))))

users_idx  <- sort(unique(ratings_sub$userId))
movies_idx <- sort(unique(ratings_sub$movieId))

ratings_stan <- ratings_sub %>%
  mutate(
    uid = match(userId, users_idx),
    mid = match(movieId, movies_idx)
  )

Q_sub <- Q_matrix %>%
  filter(movieId %in% movies_idx) %>%
  arrange(match(movieId, movies_idx)) %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(TOP4)) %>%
  as.matrix()

alpha_class <- expand.grid(
  Drama = c(0,1), Comedy = c(0,1),
  Thriller = c(0,1), Romance = c(0,1)
) %>% as.matrix()

H <- nrow(alpha_class)  # 16

stan_data <- list(
  N           = nrow(ratings_stan),
  J           = nrow(Q_sub),
  H           = H,
  movie       = ratings_stan$mid,
  rating      = ratings_stan$rating,
  Q           = Q_sub,
  alpha_class = alpha_class
)

cat(sprintf("Datos Stan:\n  N=%d valoraciones\n  J=%d películas\n  H=%d clases\n",
            stan_data$N, stan_data$J, stan_data$H))
```

## 2. Carga del modelo Stan

```{r cargar-fit}
fit <- readRDS("fit_gpdm.rds")
cat("Modelo cargado desde fit_gpdm.rds\n")
```

## 3. Parámetros estimados

### Pesos de género (λ_k) y umbrales del GRM (c_r)

```{r params}
print(fit, pars = c("lambda", "c"), digits_summary = 3)
```

```{r tabla-lambda}
s <- summary(fit)$summary

lambda_tabla <- data.frame(
  Género  = TOP4,
  Media   = round(s[paste0("lambda[", 1:4, "]"), "mean"], 3),
  SD      = round(s[paste0("lambda[", 1:4, "]"), "sd"],   3),
  `2.5%`  = round(s[paste0("lambda[", 1:4, "]"), "2.5%"], 3),
  `97.5%` = round(s[paste0("lambda[", 1:4, "]"), "97.5%"], 3),
  check.names = FALSE
)
kable(lambda_tabla, caption = "Estimaciones a posteriori de λ_k (pesos de género)")

c_tabla <- data.frame(
  Umbral  = paste0("c_", 1:4),
  Media   = round(s[paste0("c[", 1:4, "]"), "mean"], 3),
  SD      = round(s[paste0("c[", 1:4, "]"), "sd"],   3),
  `2.5%`  = round(s[paste0("c[", 1:4, "]"), "2.5%"], 3),
  `97.5%` = round(s[paste0("c[", 1:4, "]"), "97.5%"], 3),
  check.names = FALSE
)
kable(c_tabla, caption = "Estimaciones a posteriori de los umbrales c_r")
```

### Convergencia (R̂)

```{r convergencia}
rhat     <- s[, "Rhat"]
rhat_max <- max(rhat, na.rm = TRUE)
n_malos  <- sum(rhat > 1.05, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("R máximo:              %.4f\n", rhat_max))
cat(sprintf("Parametros con R>1.05: %d\n",   n_malos))
cat(sprintf("Diagnostico:           %s\n",
            ifelse(rhat_max < 1.05,
                   "Convergencia satisfactoria",
                   "Revisar convergencia")))
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 4. Clasificación de usuarios en perfiles

```{r post-process}
post       <- rstan::extract(fit)
pi_hat     <- colMeans(post$pi)
beta_hat   <- colMeans(post$beta)
lambda_hat <- colMeans(post$lambda)
c_hat      <- colMeans(post$c)

prob_ol <- function(eta, c_vec) {
  m   <- length(c_vec) + 1
  p   <- numeric(m)
  cum <- plogis(c_vec - eta)
  p[1] <- cum[1]
  for (k in 2:(m - 1)) p[k] <- cum[k] - cum[k - 1]
  p[m] <- 1 - cum[m - 1]
  p
}

I          <- length(users_idx)
post_class <- matrix(NA, I, H)

for (i in 1:I) {
  datos_i <- ratings_stan[ratings_stan$uid == i, ]
  logpost <- log(pi_hat)
  for (h in 1:H) {
    for (r in 1:nrow(datos_i)) {
      j   <- datos_i$mid[r]
      y   <- datos_i$rating[r]
      eta <- beta_hat[j] + sum(Q_sub[j, ] * lambda_hat * alpha_class[h, ])
      p   <- prob_ol(eta, c_hat)
      logpost[h] <- logpost[h] + log(max(p[y], 1e-300))
    }
  }
  m    <- max(logpost)
  prob <- exp(logpost - m)
  post_class[i, ] <- prob / sum(prob)
}

clase_usuario <- as.integer(apply(post_class, 1, function(fila) {
  if (all(is.nan(fila)) || all(is.na(fila))) return(1L)
  which.max(fila)
}))

perfil_usuario <- alpha_class[clase_usuario, , drop = FALSE]
profile_mean   <- colMeans(perfil_usuario)
```

### Mapa de calor: probabilidades posteriores de clase


## 5. Comparación GPDM vs. CFG (replica Tabla 1 del artículo)

### 5.1 Predicciones del GPDM en test

```{r preds-gpdm}
# Q matrix con movieId como rownames
Q_num <- Q_matrix %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(TOP4)) %>%
  as.matrix()
rownames(Q_num) <- as.character(Q_matrix$movieId)

movies_model <- as.character(movies_idx)

# Filtrar test a peliculas del modelo y tomar muestra
test_gpdm <- ratings_test %>%
  filter(movieId %in% as.integer(movies_model))

set.seed(42)
n_test    <- min(3000, nrow(test_gpdm))
test_gpdm <- test_gpdm[sample(nrow(test_gpdm), n_test), ]

cat(sprintf("Calculando predicciones GPDM sobre %d valoraciones de test...\n", nrow(test_gpdm)))

pred_wa_vec <- numeric(nrow(test_gpdm))
pred_mp_vec <- integer(nrow(test_gpdm))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(test_gpdm))) {
  mid_c    <- as.character(test_gpdm$movieId[i])
  mid_stan <- match(mid_c, movies_model)

  if (is.na(mid_stan) || !mid_c %in% rownames(Q_num)) {
    pred_wa_vec[i] <- NA_real_
    pred_mp_vec[i] <- NA_integer_
    next
  }

  p_tot <- rep(0.0, 5)
  for (h in 1:H) {
    eta   <- beta_hat[mid_stan] +
      sum(Q_num[mid_c, ] * lambda_hat * alpha_class[h, ])
    p_h   <- prob_ol(eta, c_hat)
    p_tot <- p_tot + pi_hat[h] * p_h
  }

  # Proteccion: cubre NA, NaN e Inf
  if (!all(is.finite(p_tot)) || sum(p_tot) < 1e-10) {
    pred_wa_vec[i] <- 3L
    pred_mp_vec[i] <- 3L
  } else {
    pred_wa_vec[i] <- sum(1:5 * p_tot)
    pred_mp_vec[i] <- which.max(p_tot)
  }
}

test_gpdm$pred_wa <- pred_wa_vec
test_gpdm$pred_mp <- pred_mp_vec
test_gpdm <- test_gpdm[!is.na(test_gpdm$pred_wa), ]

mae_wa  <- mean(abs(test_gpdm$rating - test_gpdm$pred_wa))
rmse_wa <- sqrt(mean((test_gpdm$rating - test_gpdm$pred_wa)^2))
mae_mp  <- mean(abs(test_gpdm$rating - test_gpdm$pred_mp))
rmse_mp <- sqrt(mean((test_gpdm$rating - test_gpdm$pred_mp)^2))

cat(sprintf("GPDM Wei.Avg:  MAE=%.3f  RMSE=%.3f\n", mae_wa, rmse_wa))
cat(sprintf("GPDM Max.Prob: MAE=%.3f  RMSE=%.3f\n", mae_mp, rmse_mp))
```

### 5.2 Modelo de referencia: CFG (Content Filtering of Genres)

```{r cfg, cache=TRUE}
jaccard <- function(a, b) {
  inter <- sum(a & b)
  union <- sum(a | b)
  if (union == 0) return(0)
  inter / union
}

predecir_cfg <- function(uid, mid, ratings_df, Q_mat, k) {
  vistas <- ratings_df[ratings_df$userId == uid, ]
  if (nrow(vistas) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mid_c <- as.character(mid)
  if (!mid_c %in% rownames(Q_mat)) return(NA_real_)
  q_t  <- Q_mat[mid_c, ]
  mids <- as.character(vistas$movieId)
  sims <- sapply(mids, function(m) {
    if (!m %in% rownames(Q_mat)) return(0)
    jaccard(q_t, Q_mat[m, ])
  })
  ord <- order(sims, decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(k, length(sims))]
  s   <- sims[ord]
  r   <- vistas$rating[ord]
  ok  <- s > 0
  if (!any(ok)) return(mean(ratings_df$rating))
  sum(s[ok] * r[ok]) / sum(s[ok])
}

set.seed(1)
test_cfg <- ratings_test %>%
  filter(movieId %in% Q_matrix$movieId)
test_cfg <- test_cfg[sample(nrow(test_cfg), min(2000, nrow(test_cfg))), ]

resultados_cfg <- lapply(c(50, 100, 200), function(k_val) {
  cat(sprintf("CFG k=%d...\n", k_val))
  preds <- numeric(nrow(test_cfg))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(test_cfg))) {
    preds[i] <- predecir_cfg(
      test_cfg$userId[i],
      test_cfg$movieId[i],
      ratings_train,
      Q_num,
      k_val
    )
  }
  ok <- !is.na(preds)
  data.frame(
    k    = k_val,
    MAE  = mean(abs(test_cfg$rating[ok] - preds[ok])),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((test_cfg$rating[ok] - preds[ok])^2))
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()
```

### 5.3 Tabla comparativa (Tabla 1 del articulo)

```{r tabla-comparativa}
tabla_comp <- data.frame(
  Modelo = c("GPDM Wei.Avg", "GPDM Max.Prob",
             "CFG (k=50)", "CFG (k=100)", "CFG (k=200)"),
  MAE    = round(c(mae_wa, mae_mp, resultados_cfg$MAE),  3),
  RMSE   = round(c(rmse_wa, rmse_mp, resultados_cfg$RMSE), 3)
)

kable(tabla_comp,
      caption = "Comparacion MAE y RMSE: GPDM vs CFG (conjunto de test)")

# Valores del articulo para comparar
ref <- data.frame(
  Modelo = c("GPDM Wei.Avg", "GPDM Max.Prob",
             "CFG (k=50)", "CFG (k=100)", "CFG (k=200)"),
  MAE    = c(0.662, 0.699, 0.806, 0.873, 0.927),
  RMSE   = c(0.961, 0.887, 1.034, 1.111, 1.173)
)

kable(ref,
      caption = "Referencia: valores del articulo (DB1, 6978 usuarios train, estimacion EM)")

cat("\nNota: las diferencias son esperables.\n")
cat("El modelo Stan se ajusto con 100 usuarios vs 6978 del articulo.\n")
```
